name: inbox-triage
description: Job-search inbox triage agent. promptfoo evals for node and end-to-end graphs.

scripts.generate:synthetic: python evals/datasets/generate.py evals/datasets/synthetic.jsonl && python evals/datasets/to_promptfoo.py evals/datasets/synthetic.jsonl evals/datasets/synthetic.promptfoo.jsonl
scripts.eval:classify: mkdir -p evals/results && npm run generate:synthetic && PYTHONPATH=. promptfoo eval -c evals/promptfooconfig/classify.yaml -o evals/results/classify.json && python -m evals.calibrate evals/results/classify.json
scripts.eval:extract: mkdir -p evals/results && npm run generate:synthetic && PYTHONPATH=. promptfoo eval -c evals/promptfooconfig/extract.yaml -o evals/results/extract.json
scripts.eval:match: mkdir -p evals/results && npm run generate:synthetic && PYTHONPATH=. promptfoo eval -c evals/promptfooconfig/match.yaml -o evals/results/match.json
scripts.eval:e2e: mkdir -p evals/results && npm run generate:synthetic && PYTHONPATH=. PROMPTFOO_FAILED_TEST_EXIT_CODE=0 promptfoo eval -c evals/promptfooconfig/e2e.yaml --no-cache -o evals/results/e2e.json && python -m evals.report evals/results/e2e.json --suite e2e && python -m evals.calibrate evals/results/e2e.json
scripts.eval:redteam: mkdir -p evals/results && npm run generate:synthetic && PYTHONPATH=. PROMPTFOO_FAILED_TEST_EXIT_CODE=0 promptfoo eval -c evals/promptfooconfig/redteam.yaml --no-cache -o evals/results/redteam.json && python -m evals.report evals/results/redteam.json --suite redteam
